texts: On day 259 of Year 1, Coraline Ash lit the lantern of the Harbor Station at sundown on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch.
Coraline Ash completed thirty solo nights.
Coraline Ash's solo count reached thirty.
Coraline Ash's solo count was large.
Pell and Coraline Ash met at dawn on day 260 of Year 1.
Coraline Ash and Pell walked back to Aelmere together.
The Council met in an informal session on day 260 of Year 1.
The Council invested Coraline Ash as a Keeper.
Coraline Ash lit her first lantern as a Keeper at sundown.
Meren Tallowhand placed a hand on Coraline Ash's shoulder.
Every villager present repeated the phrase.

q1_issues.issue: The temporal adjunct "on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch" becomes (Ordinal sk_light_1 30 sk_stretch_1), which ranks the lighting event rather than the night and fills Ordinal's scale slot with an entity witness instead of an ordering event or dimension, while the event gets no Time link to that night at all.
(Inheritance solo_count solo) exposes a modifier genus that fails the predication test - a count is not itself solo - so solo should have stayed inside the compound symbol.
(Member coraline_ash keeper) repeats verbatim the atom already emitted at s8_keeper_flat, asserting one fact twice.

q2_gaps: ordinal-position temporal adjunct - "on the Nth night of <interval>" locating an event in time has no licensed Time encoding (Ordinal's scale slot takes an ordering event or dimension, not an interval entity)
review.notes: Roles, the collective/distributive splits, the s8 investiture State-result shape and the s12 adjectivally-restricted universal with its QuantifierPhrase companion all follow the instruction set. Name and typing atoms are complete, and "the Council" correctly stays a Name-less common noun.

issues.reason: Ordinal is `(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)` with the scale being an ordering event lemma or an -est dimension (the parse's own `(Ordinal sk_lantern_2 1 light)` shows the shape), so an individual interval witness `sk_stretch_1` in the scale slot is ill-typed, and ranking the lighting event 30th asserts something the sentence — which ranks the night — never states.

Compound decomposition exposes a modifier genus only when the modifier is predicable of the referent ('the contractor is senior'); *'the count is solo' fails that test, so `(Inheritance solo_count solo)` is an unlicensed and false atom and 'solo' should have stayed inside the compound symbol.

The duplication is real and does double-count evidence in exactly the way the Input section warns about, but that no-re-emit rule is scoped to CONTEXT atoms and each emission is independently licensed here — s8 by the State-result dual-emit and s9 by the depictive rule for 'as a Keeper' — so the repeated atom is redundancy, not false, ill-typed or over-asserted content.

gaps_confirmed: an ordinal-position temporal adjunct — 'on the Nth night of <interval>' — has no licensed encoding: Time takes calendar terms or deictic/named constants (not an entity), and Ordinal's scale slot takes an ordering event lemma or dimension (not an interval witness)
new_gaps: a role- or phase-restricted ordinal — 'her first lantern **as a Keeper**' — has no licensed carrier: `(Ordinal <entity> <n> <scale>)` has no slot for the domain the rank is taken within, so the restriction is dropped and rank 1 is asserted over the unrestricted lighting ordering, which the same passage contradicts (she lit a lantern on day 259, before the investiture); a licensed form would need to carry the restricting phase/role alongside the entity, rank and scale
adjudication.defect_summary: For issue 0 no compliant form is licensed — the night cannot be ranked inside an interval entity and cannot fill a Time slot, so the instruction set's only licensed move was to leave the adjunct out and record the gap, and the atom emitted instead is both ill-typed and about the wrong referent. For issue 1 the compliant form is `(Member sk_count_1 solo_count)` plus the head genus `(Inheritance solo_count count)` alone, with 'solo' left inside the compound symbol.
adjudication.notes: A further defect the review missed: `(Ordinal sk_lantern_2 1 light)` (index 71) drops the 'as a Keeper' restriction and so claims rank 1 over the whole lighting ordering, contradicting the day-259 lighting in the same passage — filed above as a new gap. The sibling `(Inheritance solo_stretch solo)` / `(Inheritance solo_night solo)` atoms are not the same error, since 'solo' is predicable of a period but not of a count.
